plan.addresses: Fixed row-major grid has 20 incoming source slots and one bias per receiver. Only a nonzero original birth edge whose address is currently present is eligible in dense formats. Later regrowth at a birth address restores that address's eligibility. Store one reserved code or NaN sentinel for an absent birth address. A zero produced by quantization is a legitimate target on an eligible address.
plan.decision: In each of two independent cohorts, average 16/64/128 equally within world. For both X and A/B/X all correct, require the full paired crossed 95% interval versus exact to lie strictly within [-.02,+.02]. Smallest qualifying tested dense payload wins. Per-age and per-object results are also shown; they retain their own intervals.
plan.memory_accounting: Actual .bin payload bytes. The live graph, temporary fp32 decode tensors, evaluation activities and container filesystem overhead are additional.
plan.packing: Dense q formats store 20 fp32 symmetric max-absolute scales (80 B), then 420 little-endian bit-packed words across all rows with zero end padding. Codes use round-to-nearest-even and symmetric signed levels ±(2^(b-1)-1). Binary16/binary32 store 420 little-endian words with unused NaN sentinels at absent weights. Mode is selected externally.
plan.physical: Four A and four B studies, then A absent with B repetition matching the published compact-reference assay. Four crossed A/B laws and two X laws are averaged within each geometry for resampling. Live parameters, traces, activities and native edits stay fp32. After the native commit, current eligible addresses and every bias move .12 toward the fixed decoded template and exact native post-write ticks are replayed.
plan.sparse: FP32 biases (80 B), forty lowest-index-tie-broken largest-magnitude eligible weights (160 B), sorted 9-bit dense addresses (45 B), and 5 padding bytes. Only selected weights receive the reference pull, with all others retaining native writes. The sparse comparator occupies the same 290 B as q4.
